title: Windows and Dedupe
hints: `Windows` loops over start indices, not over values. `Dedupe` needs two variables that live outside its range loop: the previous value and a flag saying whether there is one yet.

`Windows`: return early when `k < 1`; then `for i := 0; i+k <= len(s); i++` (this also handles `k > len(s)`) and yield `s[i : i+k : i+k]`. `Dedupe`: skip `v` when there is a previous value and `v == prev`; otherwise update `prev` and yield.
